          TOTAL

          DefinitionsATV = sales ÷ transactions. UPT = units ÷ transactions. Conversion = transactions ÷ footfall. BP = 2026 budget from the sales book. Like-for-like (LFL) compares only stores that traded for the whole of last year's matching period.
          Zara departmentsWomen, Men and Kids sales come from the sales book. Their transactions, units and footfall aren't recorded by department, so they are split by daily sales share and marked e.
          Stock reportInditex Caucasus weekly stock report, Armenia only, stores, online and warehouse. Values are retail value incl. VAT as reported (PVTm 400), shown in euro. Sell-through = units sold ÷ units sent. Weeks of cover = stock units ÷ last week's units sold. Zara Home household stock is valued at its average shipped price, as in the report's Armenia tab.
          SourceCompany sales book, 2025–2026. Unaudited, for operational tracking. Market notes checked on brands' Armenia storefronts, 24 Aug 2026.
